tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Make the bootstrap emit the validator's canonical no-defer sentinel.

special_apis.special_handling: The APIs remained usable in the packaged desktop app, but the manifest had to preserve cellular restricted capabilities and add runFullTrust; hardware-unavailable states had to remain visible and source-faithful.
The account watcher callback required DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue so watcher events could update WinUI controls on the UI thread.

errors_encountered.error: Couldn't find a project to run.
errors_encountered.root_cause: dotnet run was executed from the trial's app parent while the csproj was under app\MobileBroadband.
errors_encountered.fix: Run against the explicit MobileBroadband.csproj path; the preferred migration workflow is Test-AppLaunch.ps1 with the project target.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The agent completed code migration without updating the seeded migration ledger as each file finished.
errors_encountered.fix: Flip every completed mapping row to done, then rerun the validator.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent inspected the preserved csproj and shared tree, manually recreated App/MainPage/Styles, retried MainPage.xaml.cs replacement after an Add File collision, and copied seven assets one by one.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: About 15 turns from discovery through shared-shell and asset reconstruction; one failed overwrite attempt required delete-and-add.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The bootstrap omitted linked external project items, so its mapping was not the complete source closure.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent manually read linked files and Link destinations from the UWP csproj, recreated the shell files, and copied each referenced asset.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Extend Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 to resolve and copy linked project items before namespace rewrite and triage.

dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The agent ignored the skill's bounded Test-AppLaunch.ps1 workflow.
